codec.note: MUST be passed as pandas.Categorical with exactly these categories (alphabetical). Raw int codes raise 'train and valid dataset categorical_feature do not match'.

content_feature_definitions.si_mean: mean over frames of signalstats YAVG after sobel filter, on video scaled to target WxH (bicubic, no pad)
content_feature_definitions.si_std: std over frames of the same series
content_feature_definitions.ti_mean: mean over frames of signalstats YAVG after tblend=all_mode=difference
content_feature_definitions.ti_std: std over frames of the same series
content_feature_definitions.vmafmotion: mean over frames of libvmaf vmafmotion filter score

pruned_in_v1.1.segment_duration: near-zero variance in training (all ~10 s segments); ablation: 0.07 CRF mean shift, 93% identical after rounding
pruned_in_v1.1.log_si: log1p(si_mean) — monotonic transform, carries no information for tree models
pruned_in_v1.1.pixels: target_width * target_height — exact product of two kept features, lowest gain
pruned_in_v1.1.note: Retrain confirmed zero information loss: test VMAF MAE 3.65 (16 feats) vs 3.60 (21 feats). Model works for any video length >= ~3 s; predict.py analyzes the whole file by default and warns below 3 s.
